## Goal

Independent review of access control, client identity, webhooks and data integrity, with fixes for Phase A blockers.

## Context

Found during the audit: client IP read from the left-most `X-Forwarded-For` value in `src/lib/auth/config.ts`, `src/lib/auth/actions.ts`, `src/lib/auth/two-factor-actions.ts`, `src/lib/forms/newsletter.ts`, `src/lib/forms/contact.ts` (spoofable behind nginx). `pnpm seed:tips` has no production guard.

## Scope

- Part 1 (read-only report `docs/audits/SC-004-security.md`): every collection access rule, every public route (`/api/*`, `/auth/*`, `/webhooks/stripe`, `/api/cron/*`, `/healthz`, `llms.txt`, sitemap), loaders using `overrideAccess`, webhook signature and idempotency, invoice and refund paths, logging/redaction, rate limiting and lockouts, env handling. Each finding: file:line, impact, severity P0 to P3, fix proposal.
- Part 2 (separate PR `fix/sc-004-client-ip`): one `clientIp(headers)` helper with a configurable trust mode (env `TRUSTED_PROXY_MODE` = `vercel` | `x-real-ip` | `rightmost-xff` | `cf-connecting-ip`, default the safest for the VPS), used in all 5 places, unit tests for spoofed headers.
- Part 3 (separate PR `fix/sc-004-seed-guard`): `seed:tips` and `seed:tips:purge` refuse to run when `NODE_ENV=production` or the database already contains non-seed published tips.

## Out of scope

- Redesign.
- CSP (SC-012).
- Paid-zone leak tests (SC-008/SC-011, FULL is not rendered yet).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Report committed with every finding severity-tagged.
- [ ] No P0 left open without an issue.
- [ ] Client IP cannot be forged by a request header when the proxy overwrites `X-Real-IP` (test proves it).
- [ ] Seed refuses against a production-like DB (test proves it).

## Required tests

- Unit tests for `clientIp`.
- DB test or script test for the seed guard.
- All standard checks green.

## Dependencies

- SC-001
